toegepas.rede_vinder: The separable compound verb 'binneroep' is written as one word.
toegepas.fout: Separable verb 'binneroep' split in a subordinate clause, where it is written as one word.

toegepas.voor: Palesa is toe al in die kombuis
toegepas.na: Palesa is reeds in die kombuis
toegepas.rede_vinder: The story is told in the present tense, so the past-tense marker 'toe' clashes; 'reeds' keeps the meaning.
toegepas.fout: Past marker 'toe' clashes with the present-tense narration.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'reeds' keeps 'already by then' and removes the tense clash.

toegepas.voor: begin Ouma se regterpols seer trek by die eerste paar druk
toegepas.na: begin Ouma se regterpols seer word sodra sy die eerste paar keer druk
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'seer trek by die eerste paar druk' is unidiomatic, and 'druk' as a count noun would need the plural 'drukke'.
toegepas.fout: 'by die eerste paar druk' uses 'druk' as an uncounted count noun and reads awkwardly.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The proposal says the same thing in natural Afrikaans: her wrist starts hurting as soon as she kneads the first few times.

toegepas.rede_vinder: The Afrikaans idiom for a quarter turn is ''n kwartslag draai'.
toegepas.fout: 'n kwart om draai' is a loose rendering of the fixed expression.
toegepas.rede_keurder: ''n kwartslag draai' is the established Afrikaans idiom for the same action.

toegepas.rede_vinder: Keeps the tense consistent with the present-tense narrative and the 'word' in the same sentence.
toegepas.fout: 'was' jars against the present-tense 'word later' in the same sentence.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Consistent present tense; the eers/later contrast still carries the sequence.
Tighter and plainer for a Grade 5 reader with no loss of meaning.

toegepas.rede_vinder: A hinge that has come out of a post has 'losgeruk'; plain 'geruk' reads as if something pulled it.
toegepas.fout: Intransitive 'geruk' is the wrong verb for a hinge that has come loose.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'losgeruk' is the right verb and keeps the meaning.

toegepas.voor: heen en weer en dit hang
toegepas.na: heen en weer, en dit hang
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: a comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses ('Sy stoot' / 'dit hang').
toegepas.rede_keurder: Both clauses have their own subject and verb, so AWS 2017 requires the comma.

toegepas.rede_vinder: Afrikaans uses 'om' with a time of day: 'om dieselfde tyd'.
toegepas.fout: Wrong preposition with a time: 'op dieselfde tyd'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'om dieselfde tyd' is the correct Afrikaans form; the meaning is unchanged.

toegepas.voor: na Pa toe by die hek
toegepas.na: na Pa by die hek toe
toegepas.rede_vinder: The circumposition 'na ... toe' should enclose the whole place phrase.
toegepas.fout: The circumposition 'na ... toe' closes before the place phrase, which reads stiffly.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Same meaning (she walks to Pa, who is at the gate) in the natural word order.

toegepas.voor: Ouma skink vir haar 'n koppie koffie
toegepas.na: Ouma skink vir haarself 'n koppie koffie
toegepas.rede_vinder: Palesa is named in the sentence before, so 'vir haar' could mean Palesa; 'haarself' makes clear Ouma pours it for herself.
toegepas.fout: 'vir haar' could refer to Palesa, named in the sentence before.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'haarself' makes clear Ouma pours the coffee for herself, which is what the scene says.

toegepas.rede_vinder: No chair is mentioned anywhere, so 'daardie stoel' has nothing to refer to; 'daar' points back to the doorway.
toegepas.fout: 'daardie stoel' refers to a chair that was never mentioned; she sits in the doorway.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Van daar af' points back to the doorway and fixes the broken reference without changing what she can see.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'n tweede paar hande' calques English 'a second pair of hands'; 'nog 'n paar hande' is the natural Afrikaans.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'nog 'n paar hande' can read as 'a few more hands', implying several helpers, while the original is clear and only one person comes.

laat_vaar.na: vra hoe dit met haar pols gaan
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'vra na haar pols' is stiff; asking how her wrist is doing is the natural, grade-appropriate phrasing.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'vra na' is standard Afrikaans for asking how something is, so the proposal is longer without being clearly better.

vlae.teks: Ouma skink vir haar 'n koppie koffie en gaan sit in die deur. Van daardie stoel af kan sy die kombuis en die hek sien.
vlae.rede: The last sentence refers to 'daardie stoel', but the lesson never mentions a chair. A sentence about one may have been cut. I proposed 'Van daar af' as a language-only fix. If the chair is meant to be in the story, the writer should restore it.
